piece.name: Skylight Strut
piece.title: Skylight Strut
piece.notes: Cakewalk syncopation transplanted into C lydian -- the other end of the color spectrum from Gaslight Strut's dorian. Same proven architecture (ABA form, groove:'broken' at density:'full', swing:0.0, real breakdown before the reprise), but lydian's raised 4th makes II a major chord instead of the usual minor ii -- that's the whole personality of the mode (Simpsons-theme, 'Flying'-from-E.T. brightness). I-II is lydian's signature vamp the way i-IV was dorian's, so it drives strain A. Faster tempo than Gaslight Strut on purpose -- brighter mode, quicker skip in the step.

sections.name: intro
sections.notes: Plain I-V vamp before lydian's raised-4th color shows up via II in strain A.

sections.name: strain_a
sections.notes: Main strain -- I-II is lydian's signature move, the major II (from the raised 4th, F# not F) giving that floating, gravity-free brightness. Steady root_fifth bass under the tresillo, same tension principle as the original.

sections.name: strain_b
sections.notes: Contrasting strain -- vi-II-iii-V keeps II's brightness prominent while touching the mode's two minor colors (vi, iii) for contrast. One light countermelody above.

sections.name: breakdown
sections.notes: The eye of the storm, same move as the original -- no groove, no counterpoint, pedal bass, high rest_probability.

sections.name: strain_a_reprise
sections.notes: Return of strain A, rebuilding out of the breakdown.

sections.name: outro
sections.notes: Short closing tag, resolves brightly to the tonic.
